# HONU MPC GUI layout update

- Compact MPC left panel: 286 px width, reduced margins and spacing.
- Numeric entry widgets use compact fixed widths.
- Duration, excitation time, reference limits and line width moved to the upper longitudinal panel.
- Indeterminate computation indicator placed directly next to `Run HONU MPC`.
- `mu BIBS` is displayed as `normalized gain`.
- `eps BIBS` is displayed as `denominator eps`.
- Tooltips explain both normalized-correction parameters.
- Added MPC line-width control.
- HONU weights use distinguishable colors and stronger grid lines.
- Spectral radii use separate blue and black curves with stronger grids.
